run_all_benchmarks: run all CompilerGym environment microbenchmarks including init, reset, step, and observations in one command
benchmark_env_init: benchmark the CompilerGym environment startup time by measuring repeated make and close operations
benchmark_env_reset: benchmark the env.reset operation across multiple benchmarks from all available datasets
benchmark_env_step: benchmark the env.step operation for individual and batched action steps across benchmarks
aggregate_benchmark_results: aggregate and display benchmark results from prior runs as a formatted table with p50, p99, and mean
